LATITUDE_EXTREMUM.description: Passage of the target through a maximum or a minimum of its geocentric latitude: the zero of the latitude rate, which no catalog parameter is.

UMBRA.description: Total occultation of the illuminating body.

PENUMBRA.description: Partial occultation of the illuminating body.

ANTUMBRA.description: The occulting body is fully inside the illuminating body disc.

RISE.description: The target crossed the constraint boundary into visibility.

SET.description: The target crossed the constraint boundary out of visibility.

ENTRY.description: Entry into a bounded volume or field of view.

EXIT.description: Exit from a bounded volume or field of view.

ASCENDING_NODE.description: Node crossing with the out-of-plane component increasing.

DESCENDING_NODE.description: Node crossing with the out-of-plane component decreasing.

CYLINDRICAL.description: The occulting body casts a cylinder; no penumbra exists.

CONICAL.description: A single cone; umbra and penumbra are distinguished.

DUAL_CONE.description: Umbra and penumbra cones evaluated separately, admitting antumbra.

NO_CORRECTION.description: Geometric positions at the same instant.

LIGHT_TIME.description: Positions corrected for one-way signal travel time.

LIGHT_TIME_AND_STELLAR_ABERRATION.description: Light time and the observer's transverse motion.

CONIC.description: A circular cone about the boresight, bounded by CONE_HALF_ANGLE_RAD.

RECTANGULAR.description: A rectangular pyramid about the boresight, bounded by the two half-angles.

CUSTOM_MASK.description: A custom boundary carried as a boresight-relative angular mask.

EVENT_EXTREMUM.description: The instant of the event's extremum: deepest obscuration, peak elevation, closest approach.

INTERIOR.description: A sample inside the event that is none of the above.

UNSUPPORTED_LOCATOR_CLASS.description: The provider does not implement the requested locator class.

MISSING_CONFIGURATION.description: The configuration table matching LOCATOR_CLASS was absent.

MISSING_EPHEMERIS.description: The state source did not span the requested interval.

MISSING_EOP_DATA.description: The geometry needs Earth-orientation data that was not supplied or does not span the interval.

PARAMETER_UNAVAILABLE.description: A generic condition names a parameter the provider cannot evaluate, or one that does not support a stopping condition.

ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED.description: A crossing was bracketed but the refinement did not converge to REFINEMENT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS. The provider MUST report this rather than emit an unconverged epoch.

BUDGET_EXCEEDED.description: The run hit MAXIMUM_EVENTS or its evaluation budget before reaching SCAN_STOP_EPOCH; the events reported are a prefix, not the whole answer.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The receiving module's own theory. A module that offers several reads UNSPECIFIED as the one it ingests element sets with (the advanced propagator reads it as SGP4XP).

SGP4.description: Mean-element theory of SPACETRACK REPORT No. 3 (SGP4 near Earth, SDP4 deep space).

SGP4XP.description: SGP4 with extended perturbations (SGP4-XP, as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature); the same value as $MET SGP4XP.

SDNAP.description: SDN's own advanced mean-element theory, labeled as its own; carried in $OMM as a user-defined theory until $MET appends it.

FFM.description: Numerical integration of the equations of motion under the full force model of PCFForceModel (profile FFM-1).

KEPLER.description: Two-body (Keplerian) motion about the central body.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The provider's own rule (the numerical propagator refuses, the advanced mean-element propagator chains forecasts).

REFUSE.description: Refuse an arc that reaches past the rows (space-weather-out-of-range).

FORECAST_CHAIN.description: Observed rows, then the three-day forecast, then the 45-day forecast, then the solar-cycle climatology; each hand-off is blended over one day and every evaluation names its tier.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Infer: PCFSpaceWeather when the force model carries it, else the daily rows supplied with the request.

CONSTANT.description: PCFSpaceWeather, held for the whole arc.

RECORDS.description: Daily rows supplied with the request ($SPW rows; the JB2008 indices for the JB2008 atmosphere).

NONE.description: Density as the atmosphere model gives it.

DCA_COMMON_MODE.description: The open-DCA common-mode correction published as $DCL: model density times exp(s(t)), s the log-density scale of the published nodes.

NONE.description: Atmosphere co-rotating with the central body, no wind.

HWM14.description: The HWM14 empirical horizontal wind model (Drob et al. 2015, Earth and Space Science 2, 301-319).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The provider's own source, named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.

ANALYTIC_SERIES.description: A closed-form analytic series (low precision, no kernel to load).

PLANETARY_KERNEL.description: A planetary ephemeris kernel (SPK), named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.

APSIS.description: g = r . v, the radial rate. INCREASING crossings are periapsis, DECREASING apoapsis.

PLANE_CROSSING.description: g = n . r for the plane through the central body's center with normal PLANE_NORMAL (absent: the pole of the request's axes, which makes the crossings the nodes). INCREASING crossings are ascending, DECREASING descending.

TRUE_ANOMALY.description: g = the true anomaly minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE.description: g = the argument of latitude minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

LATITUDE_EXTREMUM.description: g = r^2 d(z)/dt - z (r . v) with z the component along the pole of the request's axes: the zero of the rate of the geocentric latitude. DECREASING crossings are maxima, INCREASING minima.

UMBRA.description: g = the angular separation of the Sun and the central body's centers minus the difference of their apparent radii, positive in light (the umbra of the conical model). DECREASING is entry, INCREASING exit.

PENUMBRA.description: g = the same separation minus the sum of the apparent radii (the penumbra boundary).

CLOSEST_APPROACH.description: g = (r - r2) . (v - v2), r2 and v2 the position and velocity of the trajectory on the input port named by SECOND_TRAJECTORY_PORT. INCREASING crossings are minima of the range. The $OEM must cover the propagated arc; the provider interpolates it by Hermite polynomials.

INCREASING.description: g goes from negative to positive.

DECREASING.description: g goes from positive to negative.

CONTINUE.description: The event is located and counted; it is not reported.

RECORD.description: The event is located, counted and reported; propagation continues.

STOP.description: The event is reported and the propagation ends there: the final sample is the state at the OCCURRENCE-th qualifying crossing.

PARAMETER.description: Push the value of PARAMETER at the integrated state, in the units of the $PCE catalog.

ADD.description: Pop two, push their sum, difference (second minus first popped), product or quotient.

MINIMUM.description: Pop two, push the lesser or the greater.

ONE_SAMPLE_PER_REVOLUTION.description: One sample per revolution counts, so a revolution is one independent innovation.

CORRELATION_TIME.description: An exponential correlation of the innovations over a correlation time.

LINEAR.description: First-order propagation of the ballistic and density sigmas through the remaining life.

UNSCENTED.description: The unscented transform over the hand-off state, the ballistic coefficient and the density level.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The grid template's frame; TEME without one.

TEME.description: True equator, mean equinox of date.

EME2000.description: Mean equator and equinox of J2000.0.

RK4.description: Classical fourth-order Runge-Kutta, fixed step INITIAL_STEP_SECONDS.

RK78.description: The same Fehlberg 7(8) pair under the name the full force model's catalog profile uses, adaptive.

RKDP87.description: Prince-Dormand 8(7), thirteen stages, "RK8(7)13M" (Prince and Dormand 1981, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 7), adaptive.

COWELL.description: Cowell's method: Cartesian position and velocity.

ENCKE.description: Encke's method: the deviation from a reference conic.

EQUINOCTIAL_VOP.description: Variation of parameters in equinoctial elements.

DOPRI5.description: Dormand-Prince 5(4), seven stages (Dormand and Prince 1980, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 6).

RK65.description: Prince-Dormand 6(5), eight stages, minimized error coefficients, "RK6(5)8M" (Prince and Dormand 1981, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 7).

RKV98.description: Verner's 9(8) pair, sixteen stages (Verner 2010, Numer. Algorithms 53).

RKN1210.description: Runge-Kutta-Nystrom 12(10), seventeen stages, for y'' = f(t, y) alone (Dormand, El-Mikkawy and Prince 1987, IMA J. Numer. Anal. 7). The acceleration must not depend on velocity, so a provider refuses it with drag.

GAUSS_JACKSON_8.description: Gauss-Jackson eighth-order summed multistep, predict-evaluate-correct, started by a Runge-Kutta run (Berry and Healy 2004, J. Astronaut. Sci. 52).

GAUSS_VOP.description: Gauss's variational equations in classical Keplerian elements. Integrates a reduced force model; FFM refuses it by name.

DROMO.description: DROMO, the regularized special-perturbation formulation (Pelaez, Hedo and Rodriguez de Andres 2007, Celest. Mech. Dyn. Astron. 97). FFM refuses it by name: its propagation does not reach the requested epoch to the integration tolerance.

STIEFEL.description: Stiefel-Scheifele regularized formulation in the fictitious time (Stiefel and Scheifele 1971, Linear and Regular Celestial Mechanics). FFM refuses it by name, as DROMO.

DOPRI853.description: Dormand-Prince 8(5,3), twelve stages (Hairer, Norsett and Wanner 1993, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I).

EGM96.description: NGA EGM96 (Lemoine et al. 1998, NASA/TP-1998-206861), tide-free.

GRGM660PRIM.description: GRGM660PRIM (Lemoine et al. 2013, J. Geophys. Res. Planets 118), the Moon's field, in the Moon's principal-axis frame.

JACCHIA_ROBERTS.description: Jacchia-Roberts (Roberts, Celestial Mechanics 4, 1971): the closed-form evaluation of Jacchia's static diffusion model with the constants NASA GTDS and GMAT use (inflection temperature, mean molecular mass and 100 km composition of Jacchia 1971, SAO SR 332; ATM's JR71). The drivers: F10.7 of the previous day, that day's 81-day centred average, and the three-hour Kp 6.7 h earlier (PRW.SPACE_WEATHER, or WEATHER's values held constant). A VCM's JACCHIA_70 is carried here.

JB2008.description: Jacchia-Bowman 2008 (Bowman et al., AIAA 2008-6438): solar indices and Dst-derived temperature change from the request's JB2008 indices.

UNKNOWN_ENTITY.description: One or more entity handles not found.

INVALID_EPOCH.description: Invalid epoch (NaN, out of range, before earliest init epoch, etc.).

OUTPUT_BUFFER_OVERFLOW.description: Output buffer too small for the requested count.

OMM.description: Source is an OMM (CCSDS mean elements) FlatBuffer.

TLE.description: Source is a raw TLE line pair (3LE supported via NAME).

PPE.description: Source is a PPE (polynomial ephemeris) FlatBuffer.

KEPLERIAN.description: Source is a single classical Keplerian element set.

ECOM2_D0.description: ECOM2 coefficients (PCFEcom2), in their order there.

SGP4XP.description: Simplified General Perturbation Model 4 eXtended Perturbations (SGP4-XP), as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature.

Uncalibrated.description: Not measured against independent reference states, or measured and failed

Calibrated.description: Measured against independent reference states and passed

ScaledFit.description: The formal covariance of an orbit fit, multiplied by the realism factor measured for the source and the fit's class (SCALE_FACTOR)

SourceModel.description: The source's own empirical model of its element sets' errors, by orbit regime and element-set age

PooledModel.description: The empirical model pooled over all sources, for a source without its own model in the regime

EmpiricalHistoryShrunk.description: Empirical errors from this object's own element-set history, shrunk toward a population prior identified by MODEL_ID and REGIME. Later element sets are comparison states, not independent truth; history alone never establishes calibration. HISTORY_* and SHRINKAGE_WEIGHT carry fitting evidence; SAMPLES/OBJECTS/SCALE_FACTOR retain their meanings.

CIRA_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.1 COSPAR International Reference Atmosphere Known years: 1965, 1972, 1986, 1990

GITM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.3 Global Ionosphere-Thermosphere Model GITM has no specific year versions defined

GOST.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.4 GOST atmospheric density model Known version: 2004 (GOST R 25645.166-2004)

GRAM_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.5 Global Reference Atmospheric Model Known version: 2016

HP.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.6 Harris-Priester empirical model Known version: 1962

JAC_HASDM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.7 Jacchia atmosphere model with HASDM correction overlay Based on Jacchia 1970 with HASDM (DCA) overlay

JAC_GILL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.8 Jacchia-Gill bi-polynomial interpolation Interpolates Jacchia 1971

JB08.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.9 Jacchia-Bowman empirical model Known versions: 2006 (JB2006), 2008 (JB2008)

JR71.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.10 Jacchia-Roberts analytic model Known version: 1971

JXX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.11 Jacchia static diffusion models Known years: 1970, 1971, 1977

MET_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.12 Marshall Engineering Thermosphere Known version: 2007

MSIS_86.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.13 MSIS empirical model Known version: 1986

MSISE_90.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.14 MSISE empirical model with exosphere extension Known version: 1990

NRLMSIS00E.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.15 NRLMSISE empirical model Known version: 2000 (NRLMSISE-00E)

TIECGM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.16 Thermosphere-Ionosphere Electrodynamic General Circulation Model Based on TIME-GCM, no version specified

USSA_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.17 U.S. Standard Atmosphere Known versions: 1962, 1976

CARTESIAN_PV.description: Cartesian position and velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT).

CARTESIAN_PVA.description: Cartesian position, velocity, and acceleration (9 components).

POLYNOMIAL_POS.description: Polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position (and optionally velocity). Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.

POLYNOMIAL_OE.description: Polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements. Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.

KEPLERIAN.description: Keplerian classical set in STATE_DATA, 6 values per row: semi-major axis [km], eccentricity, inclination, right ascension of the ascending node, argument of periapsis and true anomaly [deg]. SANA Orbital Elements KEPLERIAN (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.11).

KEPLERIAN_MEAN.description: As KEPLERIAN with the mean anomaly in place of the true anomaly. SANA Orbital Elements KEPLERIANMEAN (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.12).

EQUINOCTIAL.description: Equinoctial set in STATE_DATA, 7 values per row: semi-major axis [km], af = e cos(argp + fr RAAN), ag = e sin(argp + fr RAAN), mean longitude L = M + argp + fr RAAN [deg], chi = tan(i/2)^fr sin(RAAN), psi = tan(i/2)^fr cos(RAAN), and the retrograde factor fr (+1 or -1). SANA Orbital Elements EQUINOCTIAL (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.8).

EQUINOCTIAL_MOD.description: Modified equinoctial set, 7 values per row: semi-latus rectum p = a (1 - e^2) [km], af, ag, true longitude L' = nu + argp + fr RAAN [deg], chi, psi, fr. SANA Orbital Elements EQUINOCTIALMOD (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.9).

LTM.description: Lower triangle row by row, [1,1], [2,1], [2,2], [3,1] ...: N(N+1)/2 values.

UTM.description: Upper triangle row by row, [1,1], [1,2], [1,3], [2,2] ...: N(N+1)/2 values.

FULL.description: The whole matrix row by row: N*N values.

LTMWCC.description: The whole matrix row by row: N*N values. The lower triangle with its diagonal holds the covariances; the places above the diagonal hold the correlation coefficients (covariance over the product of standard deviations).

UTMWCC.description: The whole matrix row by row: N*N values. The upper triangle with its diagonal holds the covariances; the places below the diagonal hold the correlation coefficients.

SUPPLIED.description: Given with the source, by an operator or the requester.

CATALOG_SIZE.description: Half the catalog entry's characteristic size (CAT SIZE).

RADAR_CROSS_SECTION.description: Radius of a sphere of the catalog entry's radar cross section, sqrt(RCS / pi): a radar measure, not a physical size.

REQUEST_DEFAULT.description: Half the request's COMBINED_RADIUS_M: no object-specific value.

NONE.description: None: the source supplied no covariance (an element set carries none).

SOURCE_EPHEMERIS.description: The source's ephemeris or orbit message (OEM or OCM covariance).

ORBIT_DETERMINATION.description: The formal covariance of an orbit-determination fit.

EMPIRICAL_MODEL.description: An empirical prediction-error model for the source's element sets.

INDEPENDENT.description: Independent errors: the combined covariance is the sum of the two.

SUPPLIED_CROSS_COVARIANCE.description: A cross covariance was supplied and used.

NON_DEBRIS.description: Any object that is neither inhabitable nor orbital debris.

ELLIPSOIDAL.description: Separation inside the RADIAL_M / IN_TRACK_M / CROSS_TRACK_M ellipsoid, centred on the orbiting object in its radial/in-track/cross-track frame.

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY.description: The centre of mass of a single celestial body.

BARYCENTRE.description: The barycentre of a named system of bodies.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: A libration (Lagrange) point of a two-body system.

SPACE_OBJECT.description: Another tracked space object, identified by OBJECT_ID.

GROUND_SITE.description: A fixed site on a body surface, identified by SITE_ID and the geodetic fields on RFMOrigin.

GALACTIC_CENTER.description: Galactic center at Sgr A*. Its ICRS direction, solar distance, height, roll and velocity are explicit parameters on RFMCoordinateSystem. No ephemeris body code is implied by this origin.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

ORBIT_NORMAL.description: Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

MEAN_EQUATOR_EQUINOX_J2000.description: Mean equator and mean equinox of the J2000.0 epoch.

MEAN_ECLIPTIC_EQUINOX_J2000.description: Mean ecliptic and mean equinox of the J2000.0 epoch.

TRUE_EQUATOR_MEAN_EQUINOX_OF_DATE.description: True equator, mean equinox of date.

MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR.description: Mean equator of date (precession applied to the epoch of the state).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR.description: True equator of date (precession and nutation applied).

MEAN_OF_EPOCH_EQUATOR.description: Mean equator of a fixed reference epoch.

MEAN_OF_EPOCH_ECLIPTIC.description: Mean ecliptic of a fixed reference epoch.

TRUE_OF_EPOCH_EQUATOR.description: True equator of a fixed reference epoch.

TRUE_OF_EPOCH_ECLIPTIC.description: True ecliptic of a fixed reference epoch.

BODY_FIXED.description: Axes rotating with the body named by AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_NAIF_ID, per its published rotation elements.

BODY_INERTIAL.description: Non-rotating axes aligned with the reference body's equator and prime meridian at the reference epoch.

OBJECT_REFERENCED.description: Axes built from the relative geometry of two named objects; see RFMObjectReferencedAxes.

LOCAL_ALIGNED_CONSTRAINED.description: Axes built by aligning one vector and constraining a second; see RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.

BODY_EQUATOR.description: Axes in the reference body's equatorial plane at the requested epoch.

SOLAR_ECLIPTIC_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-ecliptic magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z along the ecliptic north, commonly abbreviated GSE.

SOLAR_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z in the plane containing the body magnetic dipole, commonly abbreviated GSM.

TOPOCENTRIC.description: Local horizon axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin.

BODY_SPIN_SUN.description: Axes fixed by the body spin axis and the body-to-Sun direction.

EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED.description: Axes defined by a loaded ephemeris/orientation kernel; identified by KERNEL_FRAME_NAME / KERNEL_FRAME_ID on RFMCoordinateSystem.

MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED rather than left implicit: mean equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession theory instead of the IAU-2006/2000A chain. Results differ from MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR at the milliarcsecond level and the two are not interchangeable.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED: true equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession-nutation theory. See MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS1996.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (1996) reduction (IERS Technical Note 21): IAU 1976 precession, IAU 1980 nutation with the observed celestial pole offsets applied. Distinct from TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5 (no offsets) and TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR (IAU-2006/2000A).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS2003.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (2003) reduction (IERS Technical Note 32): IAU 2000A nutation on the IAU 1976 precession with the IAU 2000 precession-rate corrections. The mean-of-date equator under this reduction is MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TOPOCENTRIC_EAST_NORTH_UP.description: Topocentric East-North-Up axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin. TOPOCENTRIC (20) does not fix the axis order; this does.

TOPOCENTRIC_NORTH_EAST_DOWN.description: Topocentric North-East-Down axes at a surface site.

TOPOCENTRIC_SOUTH_EAST_ZENITH.description: Topocentric South-East-Zenith axes at a surface site.

ORBITAL_VELOCITY_NORMAL_CONORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X along the velocity, Z along the orbit normal, Y completing the right-handed set (VNC). The object is the origin body of the coordinate system.

ORBITAL_RADIAL_TRANSVERSE_NORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X radial (outward), Z along the orbit normal, Y transverse completing the set (RTN, also RSW).

ORBITAL_LOCAL_VERTICAL_LOCAL_HORIZONTAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: Z toward the central body (nadir), Y opposite the orbit normal, X completing the set (LVLH).

GALACTIC.description: IAU 1958 Galactic longitude/latitude axes, Hipparcos realization: NGP RA = 192.85948 deg, Dec = +27.12825 deg; l_Omega = 32.93192 deg. ESA SP-1200 (1997), Vol. 1, Section 1.5.3. Cartesian X points to l=0,b=0, Y to l=90,b=0, Z to the north Galactic pole (right-handed). This fixes orientation only, not the origin or the direction of Sgr A*. Explicit Galactocentric parameters select the derived orientation documented on ROLL_DEG; choosing an origin alone never rotates the axes. See Liu, Zhu & Zhang (2011), A&A 526, A16, on the definition and its realization in ICRS; do not substitute a newly fitted Galactic plane.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

GALCEN_RA_DEG.description:
ICRS right ascension of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: 17h45m40.0409s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DEC_DEG.description:
ICRS declination of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: -29d00m28.118s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DISTANCE_PC.description:
Sun-to-Galactic-center distance R0, parsecs. NaN means absent.
Example: 8178 pc (GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10).

Z_SUN_PC.description:
Solar height above the Galactic midplane, parsecs, positive north.
NaN means absent; example: 20.8 pc (Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417).

ROLL_DEG.description:
Roll angle in degrees in the Astropy Galactocentric convention.
NaN means absent, not zero. With GALACTIC axes, the five explicit scalar
parameters define a derived Galactocentric orientation: X points from
the Sun toward the center's projection in the midplane, Y follows
Galactic rotation, and Z completes a right-handed triad toward Galactic
north. This parameterized orientation is independent of ORIGIN; with
GALACTIC_CENTER the Sun lies at X=-sqrt(R0^2-Z_SUN_PC^2), Y=0, Z=Z_SUN_PC.
All five scalars must be finite for a spatial Galactocentric transform,
with R0 > 0 and abs(Z_SUN_PC) <= R0; none has an assumed default.

V_SUN_KMS.description:
Total solar velocity [v_X,v_Y,v_Z] in km/s in the resulting Galactocentric
axes, including circular motion (not just peculiar U,V,W). Exactly three

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

SMA.description: Semi-major axis (km). Standard for elliptical orbits.

R_PERIAPSIS.description: Radius of periapsis (km). Preferred for hyperbolic orbits.

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: Mean anomaly (linear in time for Keplerian motion).

ECCENTRIC_ANOMALY.description: Eccentric anomaly (auxiliary angle in the Kepler equation).

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

NCD.description:
Native Container Descriptor.

The file-level facts of an ephemeris, attitude or tracking container that
are NOT properties of the messages inside it. $OEM, $AEM and $TDM carry the
states, attitudes and observations; none of them can carry the internal
file name, the comment area, the segment address ranges, the header accuracy
block or the interpolation order the source declared, because those describe
the CONTAINER. Without them a read-then-write cycle silently invents header
values, and a segmented binary file cannot be reproduced at all.

ONE record covers every container class rather than one record per format:
the file-level facts are the same kind of fact in each, and the
format-specific blocks are optional sub-tables selected by FORMAT. Only the
block matching FORMAT is populated.

SPK_DAF.description: Double-precision Array File container carrying Spacecraft and Planet Kernel segments: a binary file of typed, independently addressed ephemeris segments, each with an integer target and centre, an integer reference frame, a numeric segment type, and a contiguous address range inside the file.

SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.description: Scenario-epoch attitude text container: the attitude counterpart of SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT, carrying quaternion, Euler or angular velocity records against the same scenario epoch.

EVL.description:
Event Locator

One request and one report for every class of located event: shadow
passage, site visibility, sensor-field-of-view intrusion, apsis passage,
node crossing, and the generic condition on any $PCE catalog parameter.
Every class is the same pair of an event function and a refined root, so a
new class is a configuration table and a vocabulary member, never a new
record. Entry and exit epochs, duration, the occulting or observed body and
the parameter values captured at each event's instants are reported in one
shape, and the predicate of the generic class is $PCE's
PCEParameterCondition rather than a second spelling of the same idea.

Angles are radians, durations seconds, epochs ISO 8601 in a named time
system.

PCFGaussianPrior.description:
A Gaussian prior on a fitted parameter. A prior with HAS_SIGMA false keeps
the theory's own sigma and moves only the mean.

MEAN.description: Prior mean, in the unit of the parameter it is attached to. Default 0.

SIGMA.description: Prior standard deviation, in the same unit; > 0 when HAS_SIGMA.

HAS_SIGMA.description: True when SIGMA carries a value; false keeps the theory's own sigma.

PCFEmpiricalTerms.description:
Empirical along-track terms of the averaged theories: a transverse
acceleration [TAU0 + TAUC cos u + TAUS sin u] g(t), u the argument of
latitude and g = 1 on the fit arc.

ONCE_PER_REVOLUTION.description: Fit the once-per-revolution pair (TAUC, TAUS). Default true.

TAU0_RULE_LIMIT_M2_KG.description:
The constant term TAU0 is free only when this rule selects it: a fitted
B_eff above this limit, m2/kg, is replaced by TAU0 with B_eff at its
prior. Default 0.5; the rule applies only when HAS_TAU0_RULE_LIMIT_M2_KG.

HAS_TAU0_RULE_LIMIT_M2_KG.description:
True turns the TAU0 rule on with TAU0_RULE_LIMIT_M2_KG; false (the
default) leaves TAU0 off.

HELD_ABOVE_DRAG_REGIME.description:
True holds TAUC and TAUS after the arc end above the drag regime
instead of decaying them. Default false.

PERSISTENCE_HOURS.description:
Persistence time of the empirical force after the arc end, hours.
Default 24.

and SDNAP. SGP4's constants are fixed by its specification and are not

Highest even degree of the m-daily short-periodic gravity terms; 0
omits them. Range 0 to 16. Default 12.

ZONAL_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description:
Highest degree of the zonal tail (secular and long-period terms past
J5). Range 6 to 70. Default 20.

SHORT_PERIODIC_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description:
Highest degree of the eccentricity-vector short-periodic terms. Range
2 to 16. Default 7.

ENABLE_RESONANCE.description: Resonance terms on or off. Default true.

RESONANCE_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: Highest odd degree of the shallow-resonance terms. Default 31.

RESONANCE_BAND.description:
Resonance band: terms whose angle drifts slower than this fraction of
the mean motion are integrated with the rates. Default 0.045.

RESONANCE_MAXIMUM_K.description: Highest multiple of the mean anomaly in a resonance angle. Default 1.

NEAR_RESONANCE_BAND.description:
Near-resonance band at output time, as a fraction of the mean motion

DENSITY_KERNEL.description:

every object) on or off; off evaluates the atmosphere model directly.
Default true.

DRAG_REGIME_PERIGEE_KM.description:
Perigee height below which B_eff and TAU0 act (the drag regime), km.
Default 2500.

PCFSegmentOptions.description:
Beyond-Earth segment sets: Moon-centered, cislunar and heliocentric arcs
cut into segments at maneuvers and sphere-of-influence passages.

MOON_ECCENTRICITY_ORDER.description:
Moon-centered eccentricity order (highest |q| of the mean-anomaly
multiple kept). Default 2.

SEGMENT_RMS_FACTOR.description:
A segment is accepted when its RMS is within max(RMS_FACTOR x the
cleanest segment's RMS, that RMS + RMS_MARGIN_KM). Factor, default 2.

SEGMENT_RMS_MARGIN_KM.description: The additive term of the same rule, km. Default 0.05.

PCFFitPolicy.description:
Fit policy: how long an arc a fit uses, how that is validated, and what a
fit refuses.

DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS.description: Fit span used when the span rule is not run, hours. Default 48.

MINIMUM_SPAN_HOURS.description: Shortest span a fit may take, hours. Default 24.

MAXIMUM_SPAN_HOURS.description: Longest span a fit may take, hours. Default 120.

CANDIDATE_SPANS_HOURS.description:
Spans the extension rule scores, ascending, hours, each within
[MINIMUM_SPAN_HOURS, MAXIMUM_SPAN_HOURS]. Empty: 48, 72 and 120; with
24 in front when the eccentricity exceeds ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD.

TAIL_HOURS.description:
Validation tail: each candidate is fitted to the data before the latest
TAIL_HOURS and scored on that tail, hours. Default 24.

EXTENSION_MARGIN.description:
Extension rule: a longer candidate is taken only when its tail error is
at most this fraction of the best shorter candidate's. Default 0.9.

HOLDOUT_HOURS.description:
Hours held out at the end of the data and reported as error growth; the
fit then ends HOLDOUT_HOURS before the data does. Absent, the data
block's own useable stop time decides.

HAS_HOLDOUT_HOURS.description: True when HOLDOUT_HOURS carries a value; false means absent.

ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD.description: Eccentricity above which the eccentric-orbit rule applies. Default 0.5.

ECCENTRIC_DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS.description: Eccentric orbits: the default span, hours. Default 24.

ECCENTRIC_MAXIMUM_PERIOD_HOURS.description:
Eccentric orbits: no candidate longer than this is tried once the orbital
period passes it, hours. Default 36.

IMPLAUSIBLE_RMS_KM.description:
A fit whose RMS passes this is refused as fit-implausible, km. Default
100.

DRAG_PRIOR.description:
Prior on B_eff, the signed drag area-to-mass ratio Cd*A/m, m2/kg. Absent
or without sigma: mean 0; sigma 1.0 for SDNAP, 0.05 for SGP4XP.

SRP_PRIOR.description:

APSIS.description: g = r . v, the radial rate. INCREASING crossings are periapsis, DECREASING apoapsis.

PLANE_CROSSING.description: g = n . r for the plane through the central body's center with normal PLANE_NORMAL (absent: the pole of the request's axes, which makes the crossings the nodes). INCREASING crossings are ascending, DECREASING descending.

TRUE_ANOMALY.description: g = the true anomaly minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE.description: g = the argument of latitude minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

LATITUDE_EXTREMUM.description: g = r^2 d(z)/dt - z (r . v) with z the component along the pole of the request's axes: the zero of the rate of the geocentric latitude. DECREASING crossings are maxima, INCREASING minima.

UMBRA.description: g = the angular separation of the Sun and the central body's centers minus the difference of their apparent radii, positive in light (the umbra of the conical model). DECREASING is entry, INCREASING exit.

PENUMBRA.description: g = the same separation minus the sum of the apparent radii (the penumbra boundary).

CLOSEST_APPROACH.description: g = (r - r2) . (v - v2), r2 and v2 the position and velocity of the trajectory on the input port named by SECOND_TRAJECTORY_PORT. INCREASING crossings are minima of the range. The $OEM must cover the propagated arc; the provider interpolates it by Hermite polynomials.

DIRECTION.description: Which zero crossings of the event function count. Default ANY.

INCREASING.description: g goes from negative to positive.

DECREASING.description: g goes from positive to negative.

ACTION.description: What the integrator does at the event. Default RECORD.

CONTINUE.description: The event is located and counted; it is not reported.

RECORD.description: The event is located, counted and reported; propagation continues.

STOP.description: The event is reported and the propagation ends there: the final sample is the state at the OCCURRENCE-th qualifying crossing.

TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description: Tolerance on the located epoch, seconds; 0 also selects 1e-9. Default 1e-9.

OCCURRENCE.description: STOP acts at this qualifying crossing (1 is the first). Default 1.

ANGLE_RAD.description: TRUE_ANOMALY and ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE: the angle, radians. Default 0.

PLANE_NORMAL.description:
PLANE_CROSSING: the normal, in the request's axes; it need not be a unit
vector. Default absent (the pole of the axes).

ONE_SAMPLE_PER_REVOLUTION.description: One sample per revolution counts, so a revolution is one independent innovation.

CORRELATION_TIME.description: An exponential correlation of the innovations over a correlation time.

maneuver is declared. Default 20.

MARGIN_STATES.description: States kept clear at each end of the arc when scanning. Default 12.

REFINE_WINDOW_HOURS.description: Half-width of the window the burn epoch is refined in, hours. Default 2.

MINIMUM_STATES.description: Fewest states an arc must hold to be scanned. Default 48.

PCFReentry.description:
Reentry: where the averaged theory hands off to osculating integration,
where the trajectory ends, and the width of the reentry window.

ALTITUDE_KM.description: Altitude at which the trajectory ends as reentered, km. Default 80.

HANDOFF_PERIGEE_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Hand-off when the perigee altitude falls below this, km. Default 180.

HANDOFF_DECAY_RATIO.description:
Hand-off when the decay over one step, 4 pi |da/dt| / (n H), passes this
fraction of the density scale height H. Default 0.05.

HANDOFF_ECCENTRICITY_COLLAPSE.description:
Hand-off when the eccentricity collapses by more than this fraction of
a e per revolution, with the eccentricity above
HANDOFF_MINIMUM_ECCENTRICITY. Default 0.01.

HANDOFF_MINIMUM_ECCENTRICITY.description: Eccentricity above which the collapse test applies. Default 0.01.

NODE_STEP_MINUTES.description:
Spacing of the nodes the hand-off tests are evaluated at, minutes.
Default 30.

HORIZON_DAYS.description: Longest look-ahead for a hand-off or reentry, days. Default 120.

WINDOW_METHOD.description: How the reentry window is computed. Default LINEAR.

LINEAR.description: First-order propagation of the ballistic and density sigmas through the remaining life.

UNSCENTED.description: The unscented transform over the hand-off state, the ballistic coefficient and the density level.

WINDOW_DENSITY_SIGMA.description: Fractional 1-sigma density error of the window. Default 0.15.

WINDOW_CORRELATION_DAYS.description: Correlation time of the density error, days. Default 2.

WINDOW_BALLISTIC_SIGMA.description: Fractional 1-sigma error of the ballistic coefficient. Default 0.05.

OSCULATING_STEP_SECONDS.description:
Step of the osculating integration after the hand-off, seconds. Default
10.

PCFLaunch.description:
Launch initialization: priors for the first element sets of new objects
and for a deployment batch fitted jointly.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_PRIOR_M2_KG.description: A priori B_eff (Cd*A/m) of a new object, m2/kg. Default 0.01.

SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_PRIOR_M2_KG.description: A priori AGOM (Cr*A/m) of a new object, m2/kg. Default 0.01.

SEPARATION_SIGMA_M_S.description:
Prior 1-sigma of each object's separation velocity per axis, m/s.
Default 1.

SHRINK_SIGMA_M2_KG.description:
Shrinkage 1-sigma of each object's B_eff about the batch mean, m2/kg.
Absent, it is DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_PRIOR_M2_KG.

HAS_SHRINK_SIGMA_M2_KG.description: True when SHRINK_SIGMA_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

BATCH_MEAN_SIGMA_M2_KG.description: Prior 1-sigma of the batch-mean B_eff, m2/kg. Default 1.

PCFOutput.description: Output states: frame, step and size.

FRAME.description:
Frame of the output states. Default UNSPECIFIED (the grid template's
frame, TEME without one).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The grid template's frame; TEME without one.

TEME.description: True equator, mean equinox of date.

EME2000.description: Mean equator and equinox of J2000.0.

STEP_SECONDS.description:
Spacing of the output states, seconds, when no grid template names the
epochs; a grid template's epochs win. Default 60.

MAXIMUM_STATES.description: Most states one request may produce. Default 500000.

PCFSpaceWeather.description:
Instantaneous space weather, held for an arc when WEATHER_SOURCE selects it.
The TIM epoch is UTC; flux is in SFU (1e-22 W/m2/Hz).

EPOCH.description: Epoch the values apply to. Required; no default.

F107.description: Daily F10.7 solar radio flux, SFU. Default 150.

F107_AVERAGE.description: Centered 81-day average of F10.7, SFU. Default 150.

AP_INDEX.description:
Conventional daily Ap index value, dimensionless (not an acceleration).
Default 15.

KP_INDEX.description:
Conventional three-hour Kp index value, dimensionless (not an
acceleration). Default 3.

PCFEcom2.description:
ECOM2 empirical solar radiation pressure (Arnold et al. 2015, J. Geod. 89,
doi:10.1007/s00190-015-0814-4, eq. 5), in the D-Y-B frame, added to the a
priori model and scaled by the visible Sun fraction. Every coefficient is in
m/s^2 and defaults to 0.

PCFIntegratorSettings.description:
Integrator and its settings, shared by $PCF and $PRW. Units are SI. A scalar
legacy tolerance must be expanded by the adapter.

RK4.description: Classical fourth-order Runge-Kutta, fixed step INITIAL_STEP_SECONDS.

RK78.description: The same Fehlberg 7(8) pair under the name the full force model's catalog profile uses, adaptive.

RKDP87.description: Prince-Dormand 8(7), thirteen stages, "RK8(7)13M" (Prince and Dormand 1981, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 7), adaptive.

COWELL.description: Cowell's method: Cartesian position and velocity.

ENCKE.description: Encke's method: the deviation from a reference conic.

EQUINOCTIAL_VOP.description: Variation of parameters in equinoctial elements.

DOPRI5.description: Dormand-Prince 5(4), seven stages (Dormand and Prince 1980, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 6).

RK65.description: Prince-Dormand 6(5), eight stages, minimized error coefficients, "RK6(5)8M" (Prince and Dormand 1981, J. Comput. Appl. Math. 7).

RKV98.description: Verner's 9(8) pair, sixteen stages (Verner 2010, Numer. Algorithms 53).

RKN1210.description: Runge-Kutta-Nystrom 12(10), seventeen stages, for y'' = f(t, y) alone (Dormand, El-Mikkawy and Prince 1987, IMA J. Numer. Anal. 7). The acceleration must not depend on velocity, so a provider refuses it with drag.

GAUSS_JACKSON_8.description: Gauss-Jackson eighth-order summed multistep, predict-evaluate-correct, started by a Runge-Kutta run (Berry and Healy 2004, J. Astronaut. Sci. 52).

GAUSS_VOP.description: Gauss's variational equations in classical Keplerian elements. Integrates a reduced force model; FFM refuses it by name.

DROMO.description: DROMO, the regularized special-perturbation formulation (Pelaez, Hedo and Rodriguez de Andres 2007, Celest. Mech. Dyn. Astron. 97). FFM refuses it by name: its propagation does not reach the requested epoch to the integration tolerance.

STIEFEL.description: Stiefel-Scheifele regularized formulation in the fictitious time (Stiefel and Scheifele 1971, Linear and Regular Celestial Mechanics). FFM refuses it by name, as DROMO.

DOPRI853.description: Dormand-Prince 8(5,3), twelve stages (Hairer, Norsett and Wanner 1993, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I).

INITIAL_STEP_SECONDS.description: First step, seconds; the fixed step of RK4. Default 60.

MINIMUM_STEP_SECONDS.description: Smallest step an adaptive algorithm may take, seconds. Default 1.

ABSOLUTE_TOLERANCES.description:
Six or seven positive tolerances, respectively m, m/s and optional kg.
Required; no default.

MAXIMUM_STEPS.description: Most steps one propagation may take. Default 100000.

PCFForceModel.description:
The forces a propagator applies, shared by $PCF and $PRW. Flags default to
off unless stated: a force is active only when selected. No implied support
for coefficients, drag models or bodies the provider cannot supply; a
provider refuses what it cannot apply, by name.

GRAVITY_CHOICE.description: Gravity field. Default INFER_FLAGS (the ENABLE_ flags decide).

EGM96.description: NGA EGM96 (Lemoine et al. 1998, NASA/TP-1998-206861), tide-free.

GRGM660PRIM.description: GRGM660PRIM (Lemoine et al. 2013, J. Geophys. Res. Planets 118), the Moon's field, in the Moon's principal-axis frame.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter of the central body, m3/s2; required positive
when a central gravity term is enabled. Default 0.

ENABLE_HIGHER_ZONALS.description: Zonal terms above J4. Default false.

MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description:
Highest field degree; dimensionless. Absent selects the explicitly
reported model default.

HAS_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: True when MAXIMUM_DEGREE carries a value; false (the default) means absent.

MAXIMUM_ORDER.description:
Highest field order; dimensionless. Absent selects the explicitly
reported model default.

HAS_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: True when MAXIMUM_ORDER carries a value; false (the default) means absent.

ENABLE_THIRD_BODY.description: Third-body gravity of THIRD_BODY_IDS. Default false.

THIRD_BODY_IDS.description:
NAIF IDs; explicit vector, e.g. [10,301]. Empty (the default) means no
third bodies.

JACCHIA_ROBERTS.description: Jacchia-Roberts (Roberts, Celestial Mechanics 4, 1971): the closed-form evaluation of Jacchia's static diffusion model with the constants NASA GTDS and GMAT use (inflection temperature, mean molecular mass and 100 km composition of Jacchia 1971, SAO SR 332; ATM's JR71). The drivers: F10.7 of the previous day, that day's 81-day centred average, and the three-hour Kp 6.7 h earlier (PRW.SPACE_WEATHER, or WEATHER's values held constant). A VCM's JACCHIA_70 is carried here.

JB2008.description: Jacchia-Bowman 2008 (Bowman et al., AIAA 2008-6438): solar indices and Dst-derived temperature change from the request's JB2008 indices.

WEATHER.description:
Space weather held for the arc when WEATHER_SOURCE selects it. Default
absent.

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Actual configured source name, e.g. an analytic series or a planetary SPK
kernel. Required; no default.

SOLID_TIDES.description:
Solid Earth tides. Their field is Earth-fixed, so a provider needs Earth
orientation (the request's Earth orientation rows) to apply them. Default
NONE.

IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description:
Constant acceleration along the in-track axis, m/s2: T of RTN,
N cross rhat with N = unit(r cross v) (the "in-track thrust" of a VCM).
Default absent.

HAS_IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description:
True when IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false (the default)
means absent.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
Rate of change of the drag ballistic coefficient Cd*A/m, m2/kg/s (the
BDOT of a VCM). Drag uses Cd*A/m + rate * (t - initial epoch). Default
absent.

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE.description:
Highest degree of the tesseral and sectorial terms (order >= 1); the
zonals run to MAXIMUM_DEGREE. A VCM's "mmZ,nnT" is MAXIMUM_DEGREE mm,
MAXIMUM_ORDER nn and MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE nn. Default absent.

HAS_MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE.description:
True when MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE carries a value; false (the default)
means absent.

RADIATION_PRESSURE_MODEL.description: Solar radiation pressure model family. Default CANNONBALL.

GNSS_BLOCK.description:
Spacecraft block; required when RADIATION_PRESSURE_MODEL is GNSS_BOX_WING.
Default UNSPECIFIED.

ECOM2.description: ECOM2 coefficients; absent (the default) means no ECOM2 term.

EARTH_RADIATION.description:
Earth radiation pressure (albedo and infrared). It reads the Sun's
position from the ephemeris source. Default NONE.

EARTH_RADIATION_RESOLUTION_DEG.description: Angular size of the Earth surface elements it sums, degrees. Default 15.

EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
Isotropic Cr*A/m, m2/kg, the Earth's radiation acts on. Absent, it is the
cannonball's REFLECTIVITY_COEFFICIENT * AREA_M2 / INITIAL_MASS_KG, and
fitting SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS scales both.

HAS_EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
True when EARTH_RADIATION_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

OCEAN_TIDES.description:
Ocean tides. Their field is Earth-fixed, so a provider needs Earth
orientation (the request's Earth orientation rows) to apply them. Default
NONE.

OCEAN_TIDE_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: Truncation of the ocean tide field, degree. Default 30.

OCEAN_TIDE_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: Truncation of the ocean tide field, order. Default 30.

CENTRAL_BODY_NAIF_ID.description:
Central body, a NAIF ID. The gravity field, atmosphere, tides and third
bodies are those of this body. Default 399 (Earth).

EPHEMERIS_KIND.description:
Where the Sun, Moon and planets are read from. Default UNSPECIFIED (the
source named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The provider's own source, named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.

ANALYTIC_SERIES.description: A closed-form analytic series (low precision, no kernel to load).

PLANETARY_KERNEL.description: A planetary ephemeris kernel (SPK), named in EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.

SHADOW_MODEL.description:
Shadow model of the radiation-pressure and Earth-radiation terms. Default
UNSPECIFIED (the provider's: conical).

CYLINDRICAL.description: The occulting body casts a cylinder; no penumbra exists.

CONICAL.description: A single cone; umbra and penumbra are distinguished.

DUAL_CONE.description: Umbra and penumbra cones evaluated separately, admitting antumbra.

WEATHER_SOURCE.description: Where the space weather comes from. Default UNSPECIFIED (inferred).

UNSPECIFIED.description: Infer: PCFSpaceWeather when the force model carries it, else the daily rows supplied with the request.

CONSTANT.description: PCFSpaceWeather, held for the whole arc.

RECORDS.description: Daily rows supplied with the request ($SPW rows; the JB2008 indices for the JB2008 atmosphere).

WEATHER_EXTENSION.description:
What happens past the last space weather row. Default UNSPECIFIED (the
provider's rule).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The provider's own rule (the numerical propagator refuses, the advanced mean-element propagator chains forecasts).

REFUSE.description: Refuse an arc that reaches past the rows (space-weather-out-of-range).

FORECAST_CHAIN.description: Observed rows, then the three-day forecast, then the 45-day forecast, then the solar-cycle climatology; each hand-off is blended over one day and every evaluation names its tier.

DENSITY_CORRECTION.description: Correction applied to the atmosphere model's density. Default NONE.

NONE.description: Density as the atmosphere model gives it.

DCA_COMMON_MODE.description: The open-DCA common-mode correction published as $DCL: model density times exp(s(t)), s the log-density scale of the published nodes.

DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS.description:
Past the last density-correction node the log-density scale relaxes to
its trailing mean with this time constant, hours; 0 holds the last node.
Absent, the provider's rule (the numerical propagator holds; the advanced
mean-element propagator relaxes with 48 h).

HAS_DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS.description:
True when DENSITY_CORRECTION_RELAXATION_HOURS carries a value; false (the
default) means absent.

NEUTRAL_WIND.description: Neutral wind in the drag relative velocity. Default NONE.

NONE.description: Atmosphere co-rotating with the central body, no wind.

HWM14.description: The HWM14 empirical horizontal wind model (Drob et al. 2015, Earth and Space Science 2, 301-319).

EMPIRICAL_TERMS.description:
Empirical along-track terms of the averaged theories. Absent (the
default): the theory's own.

PCF.description:
Propagation Configuration ($PCF 1.0): one FlatBuffer message that configures
any propagator (SGP4, SGP4-XP, the advanced mean-element propagator, the full
force model, Kepler): the theory, the integrator and its settings, the
forces, the fit policy, the events to locate, maneuver detection, reentry
hand-off, launch priors and the output. A host passes it beside the
request; the method it invokes (propagate, fit, detect maneuvers, reentry,
launch) selects the tables that method reads. An absent table takes the
theory's own defaults; a table or value the selected theory cannot honor is
refused by name, never silently dropped. $PRW reuses PCFIntegratorSettings,
PCFForceModel and their enums, so the runtime wire and the configuration
share one definition of each. Units are in the field names and docs; every
field states its default.

CONFIGURATION_ID.description: Opaque identifier of this configuration, for provenance. Default empty.

PROFILE.description:
Named profile this configuration instantiates, for example "FFM-1".
Informational: every value that matters is carried below. Default empty.

THEORY.description: The orbit theory. Default UNSPECIFIED (the receiving module's own).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The receiving module's own theory. A module that offers several reads UNSPECIFIED as the one it ingests element sets with (the advanced propagator reads it as SGP4XP).

SGP4.description: Mean-element theory of SPACETRACK REPORT No. 3 (SGP4 near Earth, SDP4 deep space).

SGP4XP.description: SGP4 with extended perturbations (SGP4-XP, as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature); the same value as $MET SGP4XP.

SDNAP.description: SDN's own advanced mean-element theory, labeled as its own; carried in $OMM as a user-defined theory until $MET appends it.

FFM.description: Numerical integration of the equations of motion under the full force model of PCFForceModel (profile FFM-1).

KEPLER.description: Two-body (Keplerian) motion about the central body.

INTEGRATOR.description: Integrator and settings. Absent: the theory's own.

FORCES.description: Forces. Absent: the theory's built-in set.

MEAN_ELEMENT.description: Truncations and switches of the averaged theories (SGP4XP, SDNAP).

EVENTS.description: Events located while integrating. Default empty.

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

OMM.description: Source is an OMM (CCSDS mean elements) FlatBuffer.

TLE.description: Source is a raw TLE line pair (3LE supported via NAME).

PPE.description: Source is a PPE (polynomial ephemeris) FlatBuffer.

KEPLERIAN.description: Source is a single classical Keplerian element set.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the stream (SDS `RFM`-compatible string tag).

FLAGS.description: Per-entity status flags (same cardinality as COUNT).

UNKNOWN_ENTITY.description: One or more entity handles not found.

INVALID_EPOCH.description: Invalid epoch (NaN, out of range, before earliest init epoch, etc.).

OUTPUT_BUFFER_OVERFLOW.description: Output buffer too small for the requested count.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

PRWInstance.description: Instance identity is host-provided, opaque, and not a physical quantity.

GENERATION.description: Incremented on reinitialization or configuration invalidation.

PRWStateMatrix.description:
Row-major square matrix on [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,(mass)], then the execution
request's DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS in order, SI units (prwDynamicParameter).
Covariance entries have row*column units; STM entries row/column units;
an STM's parameter rows are the identity (parameters are constant).

PRWProcessNoise.description: The process noise a propagated covariance includes: P(t) = Phi P0 Phi^T + Q.

SPECTRAL_DENSITY_M2_S3.description: Acceleration power spectral density per axis (x, y, z or R, T, N), m^2/s^3.

DISCRETIZATION_SECONDS.description: Interval over which each noise increment enters, seconds.

PRWResidentState.description: Identity/state at one epoch. FRM state is m/m/s with named frame/time scale.

MASS_KG.description: Optional initial dynamical mass in kg; distinct from a missing mass.

HAS_MASS_KG.description: True when MASS_KG carries a value; false means absent.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
Explicit SI concepts Cd*A/m and Cr*A/m. Do not infer these from legacy
ignored/underspecified coefficients; require a caller-provided mapping.

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

PROCESS_NOISE.description:
Process noise for COVARIANCE: on input, what propagation adds; on
output, what the propagated COVARIANCE includes. Absent means none.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description:
Rate of change of DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG, m2/kg/s, from STATE's epoch
(the BDOT of a VCM).

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S.description: True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE_M2_KG_S carries a value; false means absent.

IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: Constant in-track acceleration, m/s2, as PCFForceModel's.

HAS_IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: True when IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false means absent.

PRWImpulse.description: Impulsive change at TDB epoch; delta velocity is m/s in the named basis.

PRWThrottlePoint.description: Piecewise-linear throttle. Clock is seconds from initial propagation epoch.

PRWBurnBoundary.description: Scheduled time gates an optional condition. At least one must be present.

HAS_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: True when ELAPSED_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

CONDITION.description: SI PCE predicate; direction and goal tolerance explicitly populated.

PRWFiniteBurn.description:
Finite thrust. RTN=(rhat, N cross rhat, N), N=unit(r cross v).
VNC=(vhat, unit(r cross v), vhat cross unit(r cross v)).

HAS_FORCE_NEWTONS.description: True when FORCE_NEWTONS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: True when ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false means absent.

DIRECTION.description: Dimensionless components; normalized after adding elapsed*time rate.

DIRECTION_RATE.description: Direction-component change per second, not radians/second.

KIND.description: The event function that crossed zero.

APSIS.description: g = r . v, the radial rate. INCREASING crossings are periapsis, DECREASING apoapsis.

PLANE_CROSSING.description: g = n . r for the plane through the central body's center with normal PLANE_NORMAL (absent: the pole of the request's axes, which makes the crossings the nodes). INCREASING crossings are ascending, DECREASING descending.

TRUE_ANOMALY.description: g = the true anomaly minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE.description: g = the argument of latitude minus ANGLE_RAD, wrapped to (-pi, pi]. INCREASING.

LATITUDE_EXTREMUM.description: g = r^2 d(z)/dt - z (r . v) with z the component along the pole of the request's axes: the zero of the rate of the geocentric latitude. DECREASING crossings are maxima, INCREASING minima.

UMBRA.description: g = the angular separation of the Sun and the central body's centers minus the difference of their apparent radii, positive in light (the umbra of the conical model). DECREASING is entry, INCREASING exit.

PENUMBRA.description: g = the same separation minus the sum of the apparent radii (the penumbra boundary).

CLOSEST_APPROACH.description: g = (r - r2) . (v - v2), r2 and v2 the position and velocity of the trajectory on the input port named by SECOND_TRAJECTORY_PORT. INCREASING crossings are minima of the range. The $OEM must cover the propagated arc; the provider interpolates it by Hermite polynomials.

DIRECTION.description: The way g crossed zero: INCREASING or DECREASING.

INCREASING.description: g goes from negative to positive.

DECREASING.description: g goes from positive to negative.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: Seconds from the request's initial epoch, negative for a backward propagation.

STATE.description: The state at EPOCH in the request's axes.

PRWExecutionRequest.description: Fixed endpoint propagation. Provider selected by the host's connected port.

INCLUDE_MASS_DYNAMICS.description: Explicitly selects 7-state integration even if FINITE_BURNS is empty.

PROCESS_NOISE.description: Process noise added to the propagated covariance. Absent means none.

DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS.description:
Model parameters appended, in this order and without repeats, to
INITIAL_COVARIANCE and to every sample's STM and COVARIANCE, so a
covariance carries their uncertainty and correlation (a VCM's 7x7 to
10x10). Each must be active in FORCES. Empty means the state alone.

EVENTS.description:
Events located inside the integration (PCFEventDefinition, shared with $PCF).
They apply to a plain state propagation (no STM, covariance, samples, impulses
or burns) by an integrator with a continuous extension; any other request that
names events is refused. Default empty.

PRWBurnReport.description: Burn times absent until reached; zero means an actual edge at initial epoch.

HAS_START_SECONDS.description: True when START_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_STOP_SECONDS.description: True when STOP_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

DELTA_V_M_S.description: Integral of thrust acceleration magnitude, m/s; not vector net delta-v.

STM.description: Both STMs cumulative from request initial epoch; SI state units.

PROCESS_NOISE.description: The process noise COVARIANCE includes. Absent means none.

DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS.description: The parameters the samples' STM and COVARIANCE carry after the state.

EVENTS.description: The located events with ACTION RECORD or STOP, in time order of propagation.

EVENT_OCCURRENCES.description: Per request EVENTS entry, the qualifying crossings the propagation passed.

STOPPED_BY_EVENT.description: Index of the request EVENTS entry that ended the propagation, or -1. Default -1.

Earth orientation for a propagation: one instantaneous row, or daily rows
of one series (same SERIES, IAU_CONVENTION and data-set provenance) with
strictly increasing MJD that cover the arc. A provider interpolates as

PRWSpaceWeatherTable.description:

before it (NRLMSISE-00 reads the previous day's F10.7). A provider derives
its model inputs from these rows and reports which ones it reads.

PRWJB2008Indices.description:
One UTC day of JB2008 drivers, as Space Environment Technologies publishes
them (SOLFSMY.TXT and DTCFILE.TXT): solar indices in SFU with their
81-day centred averages, reported at 12 UT of DATE, and the hourly
Dst-derived exospheric temperature change. A provider applies the model's
own lags (1 day for F10 and S10, 2 for M10, 5 for Y10) by reading earlier
rows, and states how it interpolates between them.

PRWJB2008IndicesTable.description:

The drivers: F10.7 of the previous day, that day's 81-day centred average, and the three-hour Kp 6.7 h earlier (PRW.SPACE_WEATHER, or WEATHER's values held constant). A VCM's JACCHIA_70 is carried here.

JB2008.description: Jacchia-Bowman 2008 (Bowman et al., AIAA 2008-6438): solar indices and Dst-derived temperature change from the request's JB2008 indices.

JACCHIA_ROBERTS.description: Jacchia-Roberts (Roberts, Celestial Mechanics 4, 1971): the closed-form evaluation of Jacchia's static diffusion model with the constants NASA GTDS and GMAT use (inflection temperature, mean molecular mass and 100 km composition of Jacchia 1971, SAO SR 332; ATM's JR71). The drivers: F10.7 of the previous day, that day's 81-day centred average, and the three-hour Kp 6.7 h earlier (PRW.SPACE_WEATHER, or WEATHER's values held constant).
